record.original_question: Given a field k of positive characteristic, classify all regular injections of the affine line A^1_k into the affine plane A^2_k.

PROBLEM. Given a field k of positive characteristic, classify all possible regular
injections of the affine line A1
k
into the affine plane A2
k

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field of positive characteristic, and let $\mathbb{A}^1_k = \operatorname{Spec} k[t]$ and $\mathbb{A}^2_k = \operatorname{Spec} k[x,y]$ denote the affine line and affine plane over $k$. A regular injection $\varphi: \mathbb{A}^1_k \hookrightarrow \mathbb{A}^2_k$ is a morphism of $k$-schemes induced by a $k$-algebra homomorphism $k[x,y] \to k[t]$, $x \mapsto f(t)$, $y \mapsto g(t)$, with $f,g \in k[t]$, such that $\varphi$ is injective on $\overline{k}$-points (equivalently, the map $t \mapsto (f(t),g(t))$ is injective on $\overline{k}$). Two such injections $\varphi_1, \varphi_2$ are considered equivalent if there exist a $k$-automorphism $\sigma$ of $\mathbb{A}^1_k$ and a $k$-automorphism $\tau$ of $\mathbb{A}^2_k$ such that $\varphi_2 = \tau \circ \varphi_1 \circ \sigma$.

Classify, up to this equivalence, all regular injections $\varphi: \mathbb{A}^1_k \to \mathbb{A}^2_k$.

(Note: In characteristic zero, the Abhyankar–Moh–Suzuki theorem asserts that every such injection is equivalent to the standard linear embedding $t \mapsto (t,0)$. The problem asks for the analogous classification when $\operatorname{char}(k) > 0$, where non-rectifiable embeddings exist.)
artifact.category_tag: Embeddings of affine line in affine plane
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is widely regarded as open. The Abhyankar–Moh–Suzuki theorem settles the characteristic-zero case, but in positive characteristic non-equivalent ("exotic") embeddings of the affine line in the affine plane are known (e.g., Segre, Nagata examples), and no full classification has been obtained. Surveys on challenges in affine geometry and recent work on affine lines in surfaces continue to treat the positive-characteristic version as an unsolved problem, and the related Sathaye-type conjecture in dimension two (an Abhyankar question) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Challenging problems on affine n-space
status_evidence.snippet: The positive characteristic version of the Sathaye conjecture has until now no counterexample, and is open even in dimension n = 2 (this latter case corresponds to a question of Abhyankar).
status_evidence.claim: The classification problem for embeddings of the line in the plane in positive characteristic is open.

status_evidence.title: Affine lines in the complement of a smooth plane conic
status_evidence.snippet: Over fields of positive characteristic, there exist exotic closed embeddings of the affine line in the complement of such conics.
status_evidence.claim: Exotic embeddings exist in positive characteristic, contrasting with the characteristic-zero rigidity.
